heroSub: Enzira eyangu okuzuula, okugerageranya n'okukwatagana n'ebizimbe mu Kenya yonna.
missionBody: Property Konnect egendereddera okufuna abantu okuzuula ebizimbe okuba nga kizibu kizibu bulungi era ekyangu mu Kenya yonna.
whoWeServeSub: Puloguramu emu ku buli oyo anoonya oba awewola ekifo ky'okubeeramu oba okukoleramu.
studentsBody: Zuula hostero ezirira eggunya ly'essomero lyo, kwatagana n'abakulu b'ekisulo, kozesa emmereere z'abayizi wewandiise mu bipuulira eby'essomero mu Kifo ky'Abayizi.
tenantsBuyersBody: Noonya mu bizinga mu bizinga bito, gerageranya ebirungi ozeewo ab'enamateeka.
propertyOwnersBody: Teeka ekizimbe kyako ku lukalala onoonya abantu abali bulumi bulumi.
whatYouCanFindSub: Londa Kwessaza oba Kugula, oluvanyuma koona ekika okuzuula ebizimbe ebikwatagana.
whereWeCoverSub: Ebizimby mu bizinga byonna. Londa ekizinga okuzuula bizinga byayo bito.
journeySub: Okuva okuzuula ekizimbe okutuuka okulufuula ewo mbeera.
whyWideSub: Amayumba, hostero, apaati, ebifo by'enfuna n'ebirala.
whyMobileSub: Kitegeekebwa okukola bulungi ku ssimu yo.
whySmartSub: Sengekjja mu bizinga, bizinga bito, ekika n'ekigendererwa.
whySafeSub: Waako ebisiike w'esudde ebirina ekikyukakyukausoma ebikugu byaffe.
safetyBody1: Nga tonnaawa ssente ow'obannamateeka, eraba ekizimbe wonna wwewummeezeeko by'okukolamu n'ebirala ebikwata ku byo.
safetyBody2: Bw'onaaba ekyangu oba eky'ekyama mu kizimbe, osobola okwaabirira nga okozesa eky'okuwaabirira ekiriwo ku lupapula lw'ebyafaayo by'ekizimbe.
studentSectionBody: Ekifo ky'Abayizi kikutiraamu amalala agabiibwamu abayizi, okukwatagana n'abakulu b'ekisulo, emmereere z'abayizi n'ebipuulira eby'essomero.
verifyIntro: Tujja kuwa enkolagana y'okukakasa ku email yo. Koona Kakasa email, oluvanyuma koona enkolagana esangibwa mu email. Olupapula luno lujja kweyongerayo bwokwenyini.
waitingForClick: Tuli kutegereza okoona enkolagana. Olupapula luno lujja kweyongerayo bwokwenyini.
tapVerifyToSend: Koona Kakasa email okuwereza enkolagana y'okukakasa.
checkSpam: Bw'otunaaba email, kebera folda ya spam/junk.
linkSent: Enkolagana y'okukakasa eweddwa ku email yo.
linkInvalid: Enkolagana eno telikoobu oba eyisiddwaako. Sabamu empya.
couldNotSend: Email teteweddwa. Kebera interneti yo odatamu gezaako.
tooManyRequests: Obu bubuuzi bungi. Wekkereza eddikika nnyingi odatamu gezaako.
